messages.content: Southwest moved Monday’s flight to the evening, and I would not reach St. Louis until after 9:00 p.m. What can they move me to without changing Thursday’s Delta return?

Because the schedule change delays your arrival by more than seven hours, Southwest will let you switch the outbound at no additional fare or cancel it for a refund. The earlier Southwest option leaves ATL at 7:05 a.m. and reaches STL at 7:50 a.m. Monday. Your Thursday Delta flight remains a separate ticket and would not be affected.
Is that the only earlier choice? I need enough time Monday to prepare for the 8:00 a.m. museum start Tuesday.

There is also a Delta flight departing ATL at 12:40 p.m. and arriving STL at 1:25 p.m. It is $246 one way. Delta would charge $35 for the suitcase and $45 for the supply case, making the new total $326. Southwest’s 7:05 a.m. flight has no rebooking charge and both checked items remain included.
So the Delta option gives me the afternoon and evening, while Southwest gives me nearly the whole day. Are there any fare or credit complications with switching airlines?

Yes. Southwest cannot transfer the ticket value to Delta. You would first request a $214 refund for the disrupted Southwest outbound, then buy the $326 Delta ticket separately. Staying with Southwest requires no new payment and keeps confirmation L8Q2RM.
For this trip, take the early morning departure. The preparation time matters more than leaving later in the day. Do not touch the Thursday return or the hotel.
Understood. I’ll replace only Monday’s Southwest segment with the 7:05 a.m. departure. The Thursday Delta return and the Cheshire reservation will remain unchanged.
Go ahead, and give me the revised record.

Rebooked at no cost: Southwest WN 1162 on Monday, October 12, departing ATL at 7:05 a.m. and arriving STL at 7:50 a.m. Both the suitcase and checked supply case remain included, and confirmation L8Q2RM is unchanged. Delta DL 1284 still departs STL Thursday at 4:15 p.m. under H6T9VK. The Cheshire remains booked October 12-15 under CHS-804621.
